title: Sleepy dolphin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3a7bd5'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1e4a8a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M0,72 Q15,66 30,72 T60,72 T100,70 L100,100 L0,100 Z' fill='#2b5fb0'/>
  <path d='M0,78 Q20,72 40,78 T80,78 T100,76 L100,100 L0,100 Z' fill='#21497f'/>
  <!-- dolphin body -->
  <path d='M22,60 Q20,44 36,40 Q56,34 76,44 Q88,50 86,60 Q84,68 72,68 L34,68 Q24,68 22,60 Z' fill='#5fb8e8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <path d='M32,66 Q50,72 74,64 Q72,68 60,69 L36,69 Z' fill='#c9ecff'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M48,40 Q52,28 60,34 Q56,38 58,42 Z' fill='#4aa3d6'/>
  <!-- tail fluke -->
  <path d='M84,56 Q96,48 92,60 Q96,70 84,64 Z' fill='#4aa3d6'/>
  <!-- flipper -->
  <path d='M46,62 Q42,74 54,72 Q50,66 54,60 Z' fill='#4aa3d6'/>
  <!-- face snout -->
  <path d='M22,60 Q18,56 24,54 Q30,54 30,60 Q28,62 24,61 Z' fill='#5fb8e8'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M40,54 Q44,51 48,54' stroke='#0b3a63' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M30,60 Q34,63 39,61' stroke='#1e5f8f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.6' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M66,30 L74,30 L66,38 L74,38' stroke='#b8e0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M76,18 L82,18 L76,24 L82,24' stroke='#b8e0ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
